question: What distinguishes sustainable utensils from plastic cutlery?

options.text: They are made from non-renewable resources
They have a lower environmental impact

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'They have a lower environmental impact'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that distinguishes sustainable utensils from plastic cutlery is: **'****They have a lower environmental impact'.**
 
• As this is clearly mentioned in the passage: **'By switching to sustainable alternatives, we can minimise this environmental damage'.** 
 
• Hence, the selected option follows with the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'They are made from non-renewable resources'** is not distinguishes sustainable utensils from plastic cutlery.
 
• **'They are more expensive'** is not distinguishes sustainable utensils from plastic cutlery.
 
• **'They have a shorter lifespan'** is not distinguishes sustainable utensils from plastic cutlery.
